artifact_policy: Use an existing ordinary export without game/backend changes.
settings: Q1_TRACE_FIRST_SLOW=1, Q1_GECKO_PROFILE=1, Q1_BUFFERED=0; actual Firefox authority, Chrome client; at most 10800 ticks.
trigger: First emitted host advance1 row with zero repair delta, valid clock and elapsed_us >10000. Retain every earlier row, bootstrap event, error and outlier.
retention: Immediately request checked Engine shutdown for both owned actors, then close the owned Firefox normally so its four-million-entry 1ms startup sampling ring retains the triggering operation.
correlation: Browser performance.timeOrigin+performance.now and Node arrival Date.now are correlated with each profiler process meta.startTime. Console-delivery uncertainty remains explicit.
limits: A trigger is diagnostic evidence, not an unprofiled performance result or proof of cause. Early stop does not claim complete-round/full5 agreement. Missing profiles and cleanup failures stay explicit. No unchanged automatic retry if the bounded window has no trigger.
